results.question: Which customers spent the most in total at our bakery during October 2007?
results.gold_query: SELECT c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalSpent FROM customers c JOIN receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 10;

  SELECT c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalSpent
  FROM customers c
  JOIN receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId
  JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt
  JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id
  WHERE r.Date LIKE '%-Oct-2007'
  GROUP BY c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName
)
SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, TotalSpent
FROM CustomerTotals
ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC
LIMIT 10;
